clauses.title: Floating rate linked to EBLR
clauses.text: Floating-rate loans are priced at the External Benchmark Lending Rate (EBLR) plus a spread fixed at sanction. When EBLR changes, the new rate applies from the first EMI falling due after the effective date of the change. The borrower is notified by SMS and email.

clauses.title: Rate reset treatment: EMI or tenure
clauses.text: On a rate reset, the borrower's reset preference chosen at sanction applies: either the EMI is revised and tenure kept, or the EMI is kept and tenure revised. If a tenure revision would exceed the product's maximum tenure, the EMI is revised instead. The borrower may switch reset preference once per financial year free of charge.

clauses.title: Spread conversion to current pricing
clauses.text: Floating-rate borrowers with no overdue dues may convert their spread to the spread currently offered to new customers of the same risk grade, on payment of a conversion fee of 0.5% of principal outstanding plus GST.

clauses.title: Part-prepayment of floating-rate loans to individuals
clauses.text: Individual borrowers on floating-rate loans may part-prepay at any time after the first EMI is paid, without any prepayment charge. The minimum part-prepayment is one EMI.

clauses.title: Part-prepayment of fixed-rate personal loans
clauses.text: Part-prepayment is allowed after 12 EMIs have been paid, up to twice per financial year, with a minimum of Rs 10,000. Up to 25% of the principal outstanding at the start of the financial year may be prepaid free of charge each financial year; any amount beyond that attracts a charge of 3% of the excess plus GST.

clauses.title: Dues must be cleared before part-prepayment
clauses.text: A part-prepayment request is accepted only when there are no overdue instalments or unpaid charges on the loan. Overdue amounts must be cleared first. For foreclosure, overdue amounts are included in the foreclosure amount (LP-FCL-003).

clauses.title: Effect of part-prepayment
clauses.text: After a part-prepayment the borrower chooses either to reduce the tenure and keep the EMI, or to reduce the EMI and keep the tenure. If no choice is made, the tenure is reduced. The new schedule takes effect from the next EMI.

clauses.title: Foreclosure of floating-rate loans to individuals
clauses.text: Individual borrowers on floating-rate loans may foreclose at any time without a foreclosure charge.

clauses.title: Foreclosure of fixed-rate personal loans
clauses.text: Foreclosure is allowed after 12 EMIs have been paid. A foreclosure charge applies on the principal outstanding: 4% plus GST if 12 to 24 EMIs have been paid, and 2% plus GST if more than 24 EMIs have been paid.

clauses.title: Foreclosure amount
clauses.text: The foreclosure amount is the principal outstanding, plus interest accrued from the last EMI due date to the foreclosure date (actual days / 365), plus any overdue instalments and unpaid charges, plus the applicable foreclosure charge and GST. A foreclosure quote is valid for 7 days.

clauses.title: Instalment bounce charge
clauses.text: A charge of Rs 400 plus GST is levied for each dishonoured instalment presentation.

clauses.title: Instalment bounce charge
clauses.text: A charge of Rs 500 plus GST (Rs 590) is levied once per dishonoured instalment, regardless of the number of re-presentations.

clauses.title: No bounce charge for bank-side technical failures
clauses.text: If an auto-debit fails for a technical reason at the customer's bank or the clearing network, and not because of the customer, no bounce charge or late payment interest is levied for that presentation.

clauses.title: Late payment interest
clauses.text: Late payment interest of 2% per month is charged on the overdue instalment amount, calculated daily from the due date until the date of payment.

clauses.title: Goodwill waiver of bounce charge
clauses.text: On request, one bounce charge may be waived as a goodwill gesture in any rolling 12-month period, provided the instalment has since been paid and the customer has no other chargeable bounce in that period.

clauses.title: Top-up loan eligibility
clauses.text: Home loan borrowers are eligible to apply for a top-up loan if at least 24 EMIs have been paid, no instalment has bounced in the last 6 months for a customer-side reason, and there are no overdue dues. The top-up amount is subject to credit assessment.

clauses.title: Payment disputes and duplicate debits
clauses.text: A payment dispute, including a duplicate auto-debit, must be raised within 30 days of the debit. Confirmed duplicate debits are refunded to the source account within 7 working days of the dispute being raised.

clauses.title: Repayment statements
clauses.text: Repayment statements and interest certificates are free through digital channels. One physical copy per financial year is free; additional physical copies cost Rs 200 plus GST.
